description: Docs bug: the 2026-10-05 docs give token create/update REQUEST permission_groups[].meta the permission-group catalog's read-only fields (category, deprecated, description, editable, eol_at, label, scopes, visibility). The live catalog (GET /tokens/permission_groups) carries those as top-level group properties; a token policy's permission-group meta is the {key, value} pair the previous docs listed. Restore that write shape.
